status: declared 2026-10-31 before the round-5 runs (plan reviews/revision_round_05_plan_for_review_round_04.md); the BTS lattice is not changed
inherits: round4_protocol.json: aperture model, error model, steering algorithm, exit targets, exact round-aperture loss; frozen settings from results/bts_round4_campaign_20261030/phase_scan_b and the round-3 robust setting

reading_noise.definition: one static reading error per realization and physical monitor location (element-boundary index), drawn by bts_round4.shared_reading_errors(bpm_seed, realization, sorted candidate locations, 50 um); identical for every setting and layout of the same realization
reading_noise.replaces: rounds 3-4 per-setting draws keyed by [bpm_seed, realization, design_index]; those runs are retained as a sensitivity

estimator.primary_population: final_test (seeds 96001-96005, the round-4 second test realizations) rerun with shared reading noise
estimator.primary_estimand: gain G = mean over realizations of the jitter-integrated loss of the matched reference divided by the same mean for the converged phase-edge setting (edge_best); a ratio of population means
estimator.uncertainty: paired realization bootstrap: 10000 resamples of realization IDs with seed 97005, the same resampled IDs for numerator and denominator; percentile 95 % interval
estimator.zero_denominator: a resample whose denominator mean is zero is reported and excluded; none is expected because the integrated loss is positive
estimator.secondary: the same estimator on the layouts population (seeds 91001-91005, full layout); sampled-shot conditional predictions and tracked counts are validation, reported with expected counts and Poisson standard deviations
estimator.rule: declared before the shared-noise outputs exist; no population is selected after inspection

final_test.duplicate_check: robust_copy is the robust strength vector under another name; with shared reading noise its steered lines and losses must equal those of robust exactly

steering_layouts.angle_weighted: full readings and knobs; septum-entrance and line-end readings weighted 10 instead of 3; position readings only, no angle monitor

execution_note: 2026-10-31: the first final_test/ and layouts/ runs failed before any output (the imported round-4 runner was not registered for worker pickling); they hold only a configuration and are retained. The stages were rerun unchanged as final_test_b/ and layouts_b/.

edge_study.search: SLSQP minimising mu_x subject to the six exit equalities, K bounds and both peak betas <= 60 m (16 subdivisions), maxiter 300, ftol 1e-12, from three starts: the configured edge solution, the dispersion-free best scan setting and the round-3 robust setting
edge_study.report: smallest matched mu_x per target, convergence flag, active strength bounds and peak-beta limits
edge_study.scope: local searches; a shift of the edge with D' is evidence for the dispersion conditions setting it, not a global proof
